note: AC-SP86-4 severance fixture kit. Single source of truth consumed by both tests/release/management_readonly/severance_fixtures.py (Python, exercises the live packages/core producers) and consumer-kit-go (Go, structural/decision-shape verification only -- see contracts/releases/management-readonly-v1/consumer-kit-go/README.md). Every scenario's expected_decision is 'fallback_required': SPEC-MCTX REQ-MCTX-7/8 and ADR-0022 OMR-6 forbid a loss/expiry/skew scenario from validating as healthy, empty, or cached-current. reason values are drawn from the closed omniscience_core.management.taxonomy.FALLBACK_REASONS enum.

fixtures.description: Evidence source is unreachable (raises on health()). Consumer must not treat a severed producer as an empty-but-valid answer.
Evidence source reports unhealthy explicitly (health().healthy == false). Same fail-closed outcome as an exception.
Consumer's omniscience-mcp-read-v1 token profile has expired or been revoked before the request boundary. A revoked token cannot be treated as still-authorized-but-stale.
reference_now minus request.evidence_cut exceeds request.max_age_seconds. Expired freshness cannot be silently promoted to current truth.
Consumer's ManagementContractPin.contract_major no longer matches the live ManagementContextCapabilityManifest.contract_major.
Consumer's pinned schema_revision_pin no longer matches any schema_revisions value the live manifest publishes.
Consumer's pinned producer_manifest_digest_pin no longer matches the live producer_manifest_digest.
